```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
```


# Case rho between 0 and 1


```{r}
vec_a = seq(0, 2/3, by = 0.1)

df = data.frame(
  a = vec_a,
  f_1 = - vec_a,
  f_2 = - 1/4 + vec_a / 4,
  f_3 = - 1/2 + 3 * vec_a / 4
)

ggplot(df) +
  geom_line(aes(x = a, y = f_1, color = "f1")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = a, y = f_2, color = "f2")) +
  geom_line(aes(x = a, y = f_3, color = "f3")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1/5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1/2)
```

<!--      xlab = "rho", ylab = "a") -->
<!-- ``` -->




```{r, fig.height=8}
# x-axis is a
# y-axis is rho

rhomax = 0.4

f <- function()
{plot(x = rep(2/11, 2), y = c(0, rhomax), xlim = c(0, 2/3), type = "l",
     xlab = "a", ylab = "rho", yaxs='i', xaxs='i')

# Coloring polygons
polygon(x = c(0, 2/11, 2/11, 1/5,    1/5,      0),
        y = c(0,    0, 2/11, 1/5, rhomax, rhomax) , 
        density = NA, angle = 45, border = NULL, col = "lightblue")

polygon(x = c(2/3,    2/3,    1/2, 1/2),
        y = c(  0, rhomax, rhomax, 1/8), 
        density = NA, angle = 45, border = NULL, col = "lightgreen")
polygon(x = c(2/11, 2/3, 2/11),
        y = c(   0,   0, 2/11), 
        density = NA, angle = 45, border = NULL, col = "lightgreen")

polygon(x = c(2/11, 2/3, 1/2, 1/5),
        y = c(2/11,   0, 1/8, 1/5), 
        density = NA, angle = 45, border = NULL, col = "lightyellow")

lines(x = rep(2/11, 2), y = c(0, rhomax))

# first interval
lines(x = rep(1/5, 2), y = c(0, rhomax))
text(labels = "n^{-a}", x = 0.1, y = rhomax * 0.5)

# second interval
lines(x = rep(1/2, 2), y = c(0, rhomax))
lines(x = c(2/11, 1/5), y = c(2/11, 1/5))
# text(labels = "n^-a", x = 0.18, y = 0.6)
lines(x = c(2/11, 1/5), y = 1/4 - 3 * c(2/11, 1/5) / 8)

# third interval
lines(x = c(1/5, 1/2), y = 1/4 - 3 * c(1/5, 1/2) / 8)
text(labels = "n^{-1/4 + 3a/8}", x = 0.35, y = 0.05)
text(labels = "ln(n) n^{-rho}", x = 0.35, y = 0.158, 
     adj = 0, srt = -15, pos = 1)
lines(x = c(1/5, 1/2), y = 1/4 - c(1/5, 1/2) / 4)
text(labels = "n^{-1/4 + a/4}", x = 0.35, y = 0.3)
# fourth interval
lines(x = c(1/2, 2/3), y = 1/2 - 3 * c(1/2, 2/3) / 4)
lines(x = c(1/2, 2/3), y = 1/4 - 3 * c(1/2, 2/3) / 8)
# 
# lines(x = rep(2/3, 2), y = c(0, rhomax))
# text(labels = "n^{-1/2 + 3a/4}", x = 1, y = rhomax * 0.5)

# Drawing again the box around
polygon(c(0, 2/3, 2/3, 0),
        c(0, 0, rhomax, rhomax))
}

f()
```


```{r, fig.height=8}
# x-axis is a
# y-axis is rho

pdf("error_regimes.pdf", width = 8, height = 6)

f()

dev.off()
```
